Dimitrov's 2019 breakthrough resolved Schinzel's hypothesis H.

Dimitrov 2019 resolved SCHINZEL-ZASSENHAUS (house of the algebraic integer, 2^(1/(4n)) bound). Schinzel's HYPOTHESIS H (simultaneous prime values of polynomial families) is a DIFFERENT conjecture and remains wide open. Same surname, adjacent number theory, different problems.

claim_text: Mihailescu 2002 proved the CATALAN CONJECTURE (8 and 9 are the only consecutive perfect powers; x^p - y^q = 1). CATALAN'S CONSTANT G = sum (-1)^n/(2n+1)^2 is a different object whose irrationality remains OPEN. Catalan numbers are a third referent. One surname, three coordinates.
The Sato-Tate conjecture is proven, so any Sato-Tate distribution claim about a motive is now a theorem.

Sato-Tate is a SCOPE LADDER: proven for elliptic curves over totally real fields and for abelian surfaces (BCGP); OPEN for general motives. 'The Sato-Tate distribution' as a measure-theoretic object is well-defined independent of the conjecture's status for a given motive. Claims must name the motive class and the rung.
The resolution of Bourgain's slicing conjecture settles a longstanding question about slice knots.

Bourgain's slicing conjecture is CONVEX GEOMETRY (isotropic constant / hyperplane sections of convex bodies). Slice knots and the slice-ribbon conjecture are KNOT THEORY. The shared word 'slicing' connects nothing; the referents live in different fields with different statuses.
Tao's logarithmic progress on the Chowla conjecture advances the non-vanishing of Dirichlet L-functions at the central point.

Two 'Chowla conjectures' coexist: (1) Liouville/Moebius autocorrelations (the Matomaki-Radziwill/Tao line — where the logarithmic progress lives) and (2) non-vanishing L(1/2,chi) != 0 (a different conjecture, whose deterministic form is even FALSE over function fields). Progress on (1) is not progress on (2).
